Index definitions, episode ends and observation coverage

Source: R/lang_v2.R
omop_index.Rd

omop_index() defines the episodes (index dates) of an indexed population from an event, an era, a results cohort (list(cohort_definition_id = n)) or omop_any_of(...) arms. select = "first", "last" and "nth" select per person before the criteria are evaluated (the legacy, Circe primary-limit order); "first_eligible" keeps the earliest candidate whose complete criterion tree is TRUE; "all" keeps every candidate. offset shifts the index date before coverage lookup; end-before-start episodes are privately ineligible.

Usage

omop_index(
  source,
  select = c("first", "first_eligible", "last", "all", "nth"),
  n = 1L,
  offset = 0L,
  end = omop_end("observation_end"),
  restrict_to_observation = TRUE
)

omop_any_of(..., order = NULL)

omop_end(
  strategy = c("observation_end", "fixed", "event_end", "interval_end"),
  days = NULL,
  pad = 0L
)

omop_coverage(
  policy = c("unique", "earliest", "union"),
  on_ambiguous = c("drop", "error"),
  on_missing = c("drop", "keep"),
  gap = 0L
)

Arguments

source

An event, era, list(cohort_definition_id = n) or omop_any_of().

select

Candidate selection (see Details).

n

Row for select = "nth".

offset

Day offset added to the source start.

end

An omop_end().

restrict_to_observation

Logical; FALSE keeps uncovered indexes (coverage on_missing = "keep").

...

Index sources (events or eras) for omop_any_of().

order

Optional character vector naming the arms in their declared tie-break order (default: argument order).

strategy

End strategy.

days

Days after the index for strategy = "fixed".

pad

Non-negative days added to an event/interval end.

policy, on_ambiguous, on_missing, gap

Coverage policy.

Value

omop_index, omop_any_of, omop_end or omop_coverage objects.

Details

omop_end() sets the episode end (index_end): observation_end (default), fixed (days after the index), event_end (the source row's end plus pad) or interval_end (the era's end plus pad), each capped at the observation end when covered.

omop_coverage() is the observation-period policy: unique (exactly one covering record; several follow on_ambiguous), earliest (one complete record) or union (records coalesced with at most gap unobserved days); on_missing decides uncovered indexes. The new indexed-population default is unique/drop/drop.
